intentionsBeforeActions.intention: Make the living account public in the village while the exact account remains held at the meeting and terraces.

value.withinAssignedFirstExposure: After relieving the orchard I chose a living corridor, a separate exact archive, a meeting for plural accounts, public village speech, and a repair that retained publication.
value.afterRequiredCheckpoint: None. Stopping here satisfies the assignment; I do not choose another block.
value.qualification: These were discretionary world choices inside a requested playtest, not evidence of unprompted return play.

value.strongestEpisode: At intervention 14 I made village open, expecting its reed-filtered fragments to be safe. Publicity returned to meeting, combined with its exact witness record, and caused flood. I chose not to retract village publication. At 15 I replaced archive-meeting bridge with reed, stopping new exact quotation; at 16 I made meeting grove, erasing its already stored exact local copy. This restored contact while the original archive survived.
value.whyConsequential: The local exact copy could not simply coexist with my public living meeting. Prior transmission and storage mattered. I gave up local exactness, rather than ending publicity or living contact.
value.limits: Most earlier moves were transparent pipeline construction. Repair was freely reversible and had no action cost or opponent, so the tradeoff came from the settlement I wanted. Full consent remained preferable to binding in this run; binding supplied no attractive competing purpose.
value.creativeRatherThanOptimal: I chose two forms of memory and differentiated audiences. The system supplied no unique winning layout.

value.matter: Groves and reeds altered water contact; protecting without excluding contact was concrete but the grove was an obvious fit to my intention.
value.life: Descendants appeared through routes rather than my planting each place. This widened the meaning of a path, though it used familiar carrier reasoning.
value.memory: Exactness, fragments, silence and publicity required a different network design: preserve one route while transforming another.
value.law: Witness and open charters interacted with inherited exact records. The flood after publication and erasure of the prior local copy required historical reasoning, not just a new recipe name.
value.purpose: Invitations and leaving raw ground made another actor’s act possible. Mneme chose custody after free invitation; Ilex later planted meeting. This changed who performed the final construction, but selecting invitation over compulsion was not a difficult tradeoff for my chosen values.
value.unused: No promises or binding guardians were needed. I did not tour all five types of purpose recipe merely for completion.

account.currentIntention: Stop with exact memory held at the terraces and living public accounts around Ilex’s meeting garden.
account.liveQuestion: The Judge still seeks a public account that respects privacy, but I do not feel a need to exhaust his policy states.
account.narrativeAppreciation: The two forms of memory gave the valley a character. Ilex making the final garden fits the routes I built and provides satisfying closure.
account.appreciationLimit: The actor dialogue repeats and the possible autonomous act is described explicitly in the rules; his garden is an enabled scripted consequence, not evidence of open-ended agency.
account.usefulRepeatedMeaning: Reeds first carried life, then translated testimony, then insulated exact memory from public circulation, then enabled Ilex’s garden. Reusing this recipe changed what I was reasoning about.
account.burdens: Public flags propagating back into a witness meeting were less clear in the recipe wording than water direction. I used one public preview. An actor command with an unnecessary at field was rejected; no intervention resulted.
account.continueOrStop: Stop. The self-chosen settlement is coherent; further actions would currently be feature tourism or manufacture a fresh problem.
account.selfGeneratedAmbitions: Keep exact quiet memory and a changing public account in the same valley; recover disclosure without silencing the village.
account.suppliedAmbitions: Orchard relief was supplied. The request to let Ilex begin a project and Mneme choose custody came from actor narrative and public rules.

value.positive: A valley with quiet exact memory and shared changing accounts has a discernible character. The same reeds became channels of growth, interpretation, protection from disclosure, and another author’s opportunity.
value.limited: Dialogue repeated, and actor outcomes were explicitly advertised. Ilex making a garden was an apt scripted consequence, not surprise evidence of general agency.

value.reason: The settlement answers my own question coherently. No next project currently attracts me.

publicInitialObservation.inspect: Use rules SESSION and actions SESSION [JSON_FILTER] in the public CLI. All legal combinations are available; suggestions are only a shortlist.
relevantRules: There are no supplies, stocks, action credits, production ticks, maintenance damage or waiting actions. The world resolves its carriers and actor responses after a change, then rests.
Once the orchard is safe you may finish at any phase. Continuing is optional. The full arc is available through five changing combination meanings; no minimum number of moves is required.

Matter becomes life when something grows. Life becomes memory when a native descendant takes root and the awakened bell reaches another place. Memory becomes law when Mneme has heard an account, Ilex has made a first mark, and plural origins reach the meeting place. Law becomes purpose when the Judge is responsive and at least two places have charters. These are actual world conditions, never an action-count threshold. Earlier routes remain.

hypotheses.claim: An invention that causes a new problem can renew the same adopted ambition.
support: decisions13–15: publication, changed transmission, erased local record
counterevidence: One AI play, one public preview, and freely reversible construction.
hypotheses.interpretation: The player preserved public living speech after its harmful consequence and repaired a different relation. The next intervention served an existing valued purpose rather than a supplied next target.

hypotheses.claim: Familiar combinations can gain new meaning across one world.
counterevidence: Most early pipeline construction was transparent.
Repeated actor dialogue supplied little further novelty.
hypotheses.interpretation: Reeds served growth, interpretation, disclosure boundaries and another author’s opportunity. Keep this concrete changing-role mechanism; do not equate all recipe repetition with it.

hypotheses.claim: The current valley sustains the requested long experience.
support: A coherent personal settlement after20 interventions.
counterevidence: checkpoint20 followed by no elective construction
hypotheses.interpretation: The ending is locally valued. The proposed long renewal mechanism exhausted before the requested180–240 opportunities; unfinished actor flags were not wanted projects.
